comment: He’s gotten better with each trip to Riviera, including a T10 finish two years ago, and selfishly I’m intrigued to see what pro shop gear he takes with him to the iconic first tee.

With only two starts remaining on Scheffler (Arnold Palmer Invitational presented by Mastercard, THE PLAYERS), burning one (of three) on McIlroy is an easy decision. Bright start, minus a few sloppy holes, at Pebble Beach suggests he's on his way again in 2026.
The way the 2026 season has gone so far for Scheffler, getting his first win at Riviera would be right on track.
Hitting the Scottie button for the first time this year, looking to make up ground, but wouldn’t be surprised to see Gotterup bully his way into contention again.
